reviews.body:
### 🟢 Approval recommended The narrow change preserves existing mappings, handles unmapped reasons safely, and includes regression coverage for both response paths. **No open issues** 🎉
What changed in this PR Prevents Anthropic chat completions from failing on previously unmapped stop reasons. **Changes:** - Adds mappings for stop sequences, context-window limits, and refusals. - Uses safe lookups so unmapped reasons leave `finish_reason` unset. - Tests all seven stop reasons in streaming and non-streaming conversions. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | python/​tests/​unit/​connectors/​ai/​anthropic/​services/​test_anthropic_chat_completion.py | Adds parametrized coverage for both conversion paths. | | python/​semantic_kernel/​connectors/​ai/​anthropic/​services/​anthropic_chat_completion.py | Extends stop-reason mappings and replaces direct indexing with safe lookups. |
Review effort: Balanced

I ran this end to end and it fixes the crash. Setup: Python 3.13.3, anthropic SDK 1.15.0, the PR diff applied cleanly onto current main (fetched 2026-10-16) and compared with a clean main checkout.

Probe: a local HTTP server that speaks the Anthropic Messages API (plain JSON, and SSE with `message_start`, `content_block_*`, `message_delta`, `message_stop`). I put a real `AsyncAnthropic(base_url=local, max_retries=0)` into `AnthropicChatCompletion` and made one `get_chat_message_content` call and one `get_streaming_chat_message_content` call per stop reason. The seven stop reasons are all values of the SDK's `StopReason` literal.

| stop_reason | main (non-stream / stream) | PR (non-stream / stream) |
|---|---|---|
| end_turn | STOP / STOP | STOP / STOP |
| stop_sequence | `KeyError` / `ServiceResponseException` | STOP / STOP |
| max_tokens | LENGTH / LENGTH | LENGTH / LENGTH |
| model_context_window_exceeded | `KeyError` / `ServiceResponseException` | LENGTH / LENGTH |
| tool_use | TOOL_CALLS / TOOL_CALLS | TOOL_CALLS / TOOL_CALLS |
| refusal | `KeyError` / `ServiceResponseException` | CONTENT_FILTER / CONTENT_FILTER |
| pause_turn | `KeyError` / `ServiceResponseException` | `finish_reason` None, no error / stream completes with no finish reason |

So the three mappings in the description work, and an unknown reason such as `pause_turn` no longer fails the call. That is the right behavior to me.

Tests: `tests/unit/connectors/ai/anthropic` gives 42 passed on the PR. When I copy the PR's test file onto main, 4 of the 7 new parametrized cases fail (`stop_sequence`, `model_context_window_exceeded`, `refusal`, `pause_turn`) and 38 pass, so the test does catch the bug.

I only ran the Anthropic connector against a local server, not the real Anthropic API. I did not check other connectors that might index a finish reason map with `[...]`.
